job.title: {mode}: {room}
overview.estimate_note: Times are estimates: they change with presence.
overview.no_rooms: No rooms yet. Add the rooms the robot should clean, with their presence sensors and cleaning programs.
rooms.intro: The order is the priority when several rooms could be cleaned at the same time. Each room needs a Home Assistant area mapped to the robot's map.
editor.not_found: This room does not exist any more.
editor.form_unavailable: The form could not be loaded. Reload the page.
editor.area_hint: The area must be mapped to a room of the robot's map: vacuum entity settings, "Areas".
editor.advanced_hint: Only for robots whose integration rejects area cleaning: these actions replace it. Work mode and fan speed are still set first. Variables: room, area_id, work_mode, pass_id, quiet, vacuum_entity.
editor.program_hint: The passes of a day, in order: each one waits for the previous ones while their window is open, and one whose window closes without a cleaning is skipped. The robot goes through the whole house, the most urgent pass first.
editor.program_no_modes: To choose a work mode for each pass, set the work mode selector in Settings.
settings.hint_schedule: The robot never starts in these hours, not even for a forced pass. Passes without a "Not before" time start at their end.
settings.hint_wake: On the chosen days, cleaning starts only after someone has been detected for a while, for example in the kitchen at breakfast.
settings.hint_robot: How Tidy Rooms drives the robot. Each menu offers all the options of the robot; each pass of a room's program can use its own work mode and fan speed (Rooms → room → Cleaning program). The robot starts only with enough battery.
settings.hint_signals: How Tidy Rooms knows that a job is over. Best: a sensor of the robot that is on for the whole job.
settings.robot_no_options: The robot reports no fan speeds.
confirm.clean_text: The robot starts right away, even if someone is in the room.
confirm.stop_text: The robot goes back to the dock and {room} stays due.
confirm.delete_text: The room, its entities and its saved progress are removed. The job history is kept.
confirm.clean_text_modes: The robot starts right away, even if someone is in the room, with this work mode:
confirm.clean_extra: Does not count as a pass of today's program.
error.robot_busy: The robot is already busy with a job.
error.area_already_configured: This area already has a room.
error.proxy_with_occupancy: Use either the room's own sensors or the sensors of other rooms, not both.
error.end_before_start: The deadline must be after the start.
error.window_order: Out of order: for passes on the same days, times must follow the order of the passes. Move the pass or change its times.
field.wake_minutes: Minutes of presence to count as awake
field.quiet_fan_speed: Fan speed while someone is in the room
field.start_timeout: Minutes to wait for the robot to start before retrying
field.job_done_delay: Minutes docked before a job counts as done
field.forced: At the deadline, clean even if the room is occupied
field.gap_hours: Minimum hours since the previous cleaning
field.restore_settings: Put the robot's settings back after each job
help.occupancy_sensors: The room is cleaned after all of them have reported nobody for the minutes below.
help.proxy_sensors: For rooms without their own sensor: the room counts as free while one of these sensors detects someone elsewhere.
help.wake_sensors: Leave empty to skip the check.
help.work_mode_entity: A select entity of the robot with its work modes (vacuum, mop, …): each pass chooses one.
help.normal_fan_speed: Used for every pass without its own speed.
help.fan_speed: Empty: the fan speed of the settings. The quiet speed still wins when the pass is cleaned after its deadline while someone is there.
help.quiet_fan_speed: Used only when a room is cleaned after its deadline while someone is there.
help.battery_entity: For robots that report the battery in a separate sensor.
help.job_entity: On from the start to the end of a job, also while the robot is at the dock in the middle of it. A job started elsewhere (app, schedule) keeps the robot busy.
help.finished_event: Event types finished and finished_with_warnings end the job right away; other types mark it as stopped.
help.job_done_delay: Used only without a cleaning job sensor. A return to recharge also counts as the end.
help.work_mode: Empty: the robot's current work mode is used.
help.start: Empty: from the end of do not disturb.
help.end: If the pass is not done by then, it is cleaned anyway with the option below (quiet speed if someone is there), otherwise it is skipped. Empty: it waits all day.
help.gap_hours: Counted from the last pass done in the room. If it ends after the deadline, the pass is skipped.
help.restore_settings: At the end of a job the robot gets back the work mode and fan speed it had before, so a cleaning started from its app does not inherit them. A setting changed by someone else meanwhile is left alone.
